rules.east_limit_why: the eastern half (x >= 4096) belongs to another agent building mines the same night: every WRITE of the pack (carve, shell, ore, lantern) must stay at least 64 blocks west of x 4096, that is x <= 4032. Carving stops at 4000 so that the shell, which reaches at most 5 cells beyond a carved cell, cannot pass 4005
rules.cover_min_why: the brief: at least 8 blocks of rock over every carved cell except at a mouth. Cover is ground (round(h), tools/ground.py) minus the cell's y
rules.authored_why: the brief: a margin of 32 from every x/z, footprint, route and the Rift that data/ authors

exclusion_discs.why: the Displaced City (data/placements.json settlement centre 3366,1755): a cavern 60 to 100 blocks under the surface whose plan, derived/cavern/plan.json, is not in a fresh checkout, so its extent is not known: keep a disc of 520
the same town's footprint in data/towns.json (2904..3035, 1645..1776), which disagrees with the placement's centre by about 400 blocks; both are kept clear until the owner settles which is right
Relic Island and its relic area under the sea floor (data/relic_underground.json): carved rock the points do not outline

rules.shell_block_why: the shell is written in 4 x 4 x 4 blocks aligned to the world (a superset of the two-cell ring, never more than 5 cells past a carved cell): it only turns water and lava to stone, and meshing the exact ring cost as many lines as the carve
rules.shell_why: every water and lava block within two cells of any carved cell becomes stone (deepslate under y0), before and in the middle of the carve; the carve is then run again so the passage is never refilled
rules.tile_why: 12 x 12 chunks = 144 chunks, under forceload's 256; every function writes only inside its own tile so a held tile is all it needs
rules.mouth_zone_why: inside this horizontal distance of a mouth the passage may rise to the surface (cover is only required to be >= 0); everywhere else cover_min holds. The audit allows the same radius and no more
rules.fork_flat_why: a branch keeps its parent's floor for its first 14 blocks, so two tubes that overlap at a fork share one floor level and no ledge of two or more is cut where they part
rules.level_why: a child branch picks its level from the one it forks from and the two beside it, by a weight that grows with how far that level is short of its share of the system's centreline (level_share, upper to abyss)

light.why: a lantern on the floor at four points inside each mouth passage, no other light anywhere: the caves are dark by design

widen.owner_words: "make some of the caves tunnels wider span from 3-15 blocks wide or something large, the part i ran through felt tight." (2026-10-22)
widen.why: ADDITIVE over the live 2026-10-22 carve (live_carve): a node's width is a smooth seeded field (value noise over noise_scale blocks) ranked over the system's nodes: the narrowest share_squeeze keep their own width (the squeezes, 3 to 7 as carved), the middle spreads over typical, the top share_wide over 9 to 15; never narrower than the node already is; tapered back to the carved width over mouth_taper blocks outside each mouth zone, and nothing is added inside a mouth zone, so the mouths stay as carved. Headroom 3.2 + 0.55 x width (+-1.6 noise) up to height_max, clipped to cover_min of rock. An added cell within deck_gap of a carved cell whose run floor differs by more than deck_tolerance is dropped, so no level is opened into another. Measured widths (floor + 1, square to the passage) are in derived/cave_systems/plan.json widen

nests.owner_words: "I would also like some random room to be added where we have habitat blocks spawning a nest or something." (2026-10-22)
nests.why: 2 or 3 rooms a system, each off a side branch: a straight flat spur spur_len past the passage's wall into an elliptical room 12 to 20 across with a domed roof; the room keeps room_clear from every other carved cell and the spur spur_clear past its attachment, so a room is a dead end reached only by its spur; at least spacing apart and mouth_clear outside the mouth zones. One activated Habitat Block in the floor under the middle (tools/nest_rooms.py). Sited once by `python tools/cave_systems.py nests --site` into systems[].nest_rooms; the build carves the recorded rooms and fails closed if one no longer fits

ore.rich_why: a vein centre's chance is centre_rate x (rich_base + rich_depth x depth below the surface / 140, capped + rich_far x distance from the nearest town / 1000, capped): richer deeper and farther from towns; the ore type is weighted by its weight and, for the rare ores, by depth_gain x (richness - 1)
ore.emerald: not placed: vanilla emerald is a mountain-biome ore only
ore.bank: data/bank.json buys coal, iron, copper, gold, lapis, redstone, diamond (and emerald) in the forms these ores drop

live_carve.what: the cells R9CS carved into the live world on 2026-10-22 (docs/STATE.md, 838,400 blocks), per system: their count and the sha256 of their int32 (x, y, z) triples sorted by x, then y, then z. Read from the as-installed pack's own `_air` lines (built from a7ccab43, the code and data of that install), not from the generator
live_carve.rule: the generator's base must reproduce these exactly or it fails closed (a re-plan would carve a different network over the live one); the pack keeps carving them in the `_air` functions and tools/cave_systems_audit.py digests those functions against these figures and checks the replayed volume contains every one of them
